descriptions.วัดโพธิ์งาม: The temple has a local heritage centre with farming tools, woven crafts, fishing equipment, old books and everyday objects from Kamphaeng Saen communities.
descriptions.ตลาดบ้านรังนก: An eco-minded community market and cafe with children's art, handmade goods and secondhand items that support a local foundation.
descriptions.ตลาดโบราณ 100 ปี รางกระทุ่ม: A historic riverside market in Bang Len, with timber buildings, local food and a glimpse of community life.
descriptions.วัดกลางบางพระ: An important temple in Bang Len, known for Luang Pho Somwang, a large Buddha image and local landmark.
descriptions.ต้นยางยักษ์ - ยางสามยอด: A large three-trunk yang tree cared for by Ban Yang residents. The tree's broad canopy and nearby shrine are its landmarks.
descriptions.วัดทุ่งกระพังโหม: A local temple in Thung Krapang Hom, known for its large Buddha image and the surrounding temple grounds.
descriptions.วัดบ้านยาง: A community temple in Ban Yang, Mueang Nakhon Pathom, along a local route that also includes the three-trunk yang tree.
descriptions.วัดห้วยม่วง: An old temple in Kamphaeng Saen, with a historic ordination hall believed to be around 150 years old.
descriptions.วัดรัตนรังสี: A community temple in Phrong Maduea, Mueang Nakhon Pathom, and a stop on local temple and community routes.
descriptions.วัดกงลาด: A historic temple connected with the Lao Khrang community of Ban Huai Duan, which holds local cultural events around Songkran.
descriptions.วัดงิ้วราย: A riverside temple on the Nakhon Chai Si River, near the Wat Ngio Rai railway station and community boat routes.
descriptions.สถานีรถไฟวัดงิ้วราย: A local railway station in Ngio Rai, close to the river, community routes and Wat Ngio Rai.
descriptions.วัดเกาะแรต: An old temple in Bang Len, known for its historic teak pavilion and ties to the Ko Raet community.
descriptions.บรอมมีเลียด ฟาร์ม คาเฟ่: A garden and cafe featuring bromeliads and orchids, with plant displays and places to pause among the greenery.
descriptions.บ้านสวนบางเตย: A riverside Thai-style homestay among Bang Toei orchards. Book ahead to ask about stays and community activities.
descriptions.ศาลเจ้าพ่อไทยทรงดำ: A place of worship for the Thai Song Dam community in Bang Len and a place to learn about local living traditions.
descriptions.วัดห้วยตะโกและพิพิธภัณฑ์พื้นบ้าน: A temple in Phaniat with an ordination hall influenced by Khmer art. Its local museum displays farming tools, woven crafts and community artefacts.
descriptions.ปางอุ๋ง Iberry Cafe & Restaurant: A cafe and restaurant beside a pond, with a landscaped garden, water views and tree-lined photo spots in the late-afternoon light.
descriptions.บ้านฟักข้าวขนิษฐา: A community garden and learning centre beside Khlong Mahasawat, with gac fruit products, snacks and boat trips through local orchards.
descriptions.เกรส ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำโบราณ 100 ปี: A tom yum noodle shop beside Khlong Mahasawat, serving traditional cafe drinks and helping visitors arrange community orchard boat trips.
descriptions.ครัวป้าเล็ก เตี๋ยวกับตำ: A local restaurant in Ban Yang serving noodles, papaya salad, Pad Thai, rice dishes and fresh coffee.
descriptions.บ้านสวนช้างน้อย: A garden restaurant in Bang Toei with shady outdoor seating and dishes made with local ingredients.
descriptions.มาดิ่ (MADi cafe and bistro): A riverside cafe and bistro in Rai Khing, with vegetarian and other dishes and views of the Nakhon Chai Si River.
descriptions.ร้านอาหารเครื่องบิน นครปฐม: A hangar-style cafe and restaurant beside a pond, with aircraft and military displays and several seating areas.
descriptions.Amber Terrace: A cafe and restaurant in a leafy garden, with coffee, baked goods and shaded dining areas.
descriptions.สวนมะลิ ดอนตูม: A community farm in Huai Duan where visitors can learn about jasmine cultivation and seasonal flower picking.
descriptions.บ้านโรงหวด: A traditional pottery community in Ngio Rai, known for local craft practices and earthenware.
descriptions.Home No.8: A small home cafe focused on pour-over coffee and its own selection of roasted beans, near Jesada Technik Museum.
descriptions.พิพิธภัณฑ์วิถีชีวิตชาวนาไทยบ้านลานแหลม: A community museum in a traditional Thai house, with farming tools and demonstrations of rice milling, winnowing and Dvaravati-pattern water-hyacinth weaving.
descriptions.พิพิธภัณฑ์วัดกำแพงแสน: A temple museum displaying Dvaravati-era artefacts from Kamphaeng Saen, including stucco, architectural fragments, pottery, household objects and votive tablets.
descriptions.พิพิธภัณฑ์จ่าง แซ่ตั้ง: A private museum in the former home of artist Chang Sae-tang, showing his paintings and documents, including large works arranged by period along the stair hall.
